correctness.rationale: The finite graph is precisely specified. A verified matching on 200 nonempty faces consists of 88 pairs and leaves one vertex and 23 two-cells; all 496 face-poset incidences are checked for acyclicity, so rational homology is only H_2 of dimension 23. The six-neighbor C6 and nine distinct neighbor signatures certify all 192 automorphisms. Independent signed-face and vertex-cycle Lefschetz computations agree on all 192 elements. Exact Gaussian integer Fourier multiplicities are nonnegative integers summing to 23 and give the claimed module; averaging gives the stated two D6 sign lines. The rational-cochain transfer argument proves quotient rings. Mod-two ranks are a corroboration, not a substitute for the homotopy proof. All computations were executed using the included standalone program and table.

originality.rationale: The theorem specifies the complete 192-element rational homology character on the canonical Shrikhande independence complex and the two-stage invariant structure under translations and all automorphisms. The exact same-complex 2026 result states a 23-sphere wedge and does not imply the symmetry action. Classical coclique work gives the face geometry but not the Lefschetz representation. The chessboard result covers the rook comparison, not the Shrikhande automorphism action. No equivalent or stronger result was identified in actual index searches or inspected full text; an inaccessible recent book and unindexed literature leave a bounded priority risk.

value.rationale: The full affine homology action of a canonical 16-vertex strongly regular graph is a natural complete topological symmetry invariant; the 192-element character and its translation Fourier decomposition answer a motivated mathematical gap left by the nonequivariant classification. The contrast between two surviving translation-invariant classes, zero full-group invariants, and a single rook-graph translation-invariant class gives a useful structural distinction in rational quotient topology. This is not an arbitrary parameter slice or only a reprint of known coclique and Betti tables.
